Synopsis:
The UK's National Audit Office warns that Defra has insufficiently prepared the food supply chain for growing risks including climate shocks, disease and cyber-attacks. With over a third of food imported — largely through four ports — the system is structurally exposed. Key gaps include inadequate industry collaboration since Covid, unclear guidance to local resilience bodies, and cold storage/logistics infrastructure excluded from critical national infrastructure protections. The watchdog urges stronger cross-sector planning and international benchmarking.
